text:
alex cox: quick handoff — current status:
- Incident INC-324 (embed evictions) is stable for ~18m after scaling and cache warming.
- Mitigations applied: scaled +2 nodes in us-west1, reduced ingest concurrency, increased kv cache high-water mark.
- Logs: `kvcache: evict=0.04% window=300s` (tail looks good).

maria lin: thanks. i pushed PR #4567 to lower eviction sensitivity and add a short retry on snapshot write. needs review from jamal.

jamal rao: on it, will review in ~15-20m. quick note: saw repeated `Err: timeout writing snapshot` from shard-5 around 03:12 UTC — might be transient PVC iops spike.

oncall-bot: ALERT: svc-prod-db-pvc iops spike (us-west1) — 95th=4200, baseline=1200. Correlated with embed-ingest surge. dashboard: https://monitoring.redwood.example.com/d/abcd/pvc-iops?orgId=1

alex cox: confirmed. i throttled concurrent ingest workers to 12 in eu & us-west to ease IO. tail latency improved from 420ms -> 180ms over 8m. :thumbsup:

tess wong: handoff summary / next steps:
- jamal: review + merge PR #4567, then watch eviction % and snapshot error rate (shard-5).
- maria: keep an eye on evictions metric; if it creeps >5% for >10m, escalate and rollback concurrency change.
- alex: follow up with infra on short-term PVC throughput bump for affected pool.
- oncall: if snapshot timeouts persist after retries, trigger infra incident.

maria lin: blocker: can't reproduce PVC iops behavior in staging (we don't have same multitenant ingest). filing infra ticket to request temporary higher iops on test cluster: https://tickets.redwood.example.com/TICKET-789

jamal rao: pinged @eng-infra in the ticket thread. i'll merge once i get one more approval and run a small canary (5% traffic) for 10m.

alex cox: leaving oncall to tess now. if anything flares i'll jump back in. passing baton. :wave:

tess wong: taking over — will do a 30m check-in after PR merge and monitor the dashboard. thanks everyone.
